gate1_performance.detail: SR 0.364 (target 2.0, FAIL), CAGR 3.87% (target 16%, FAIL), MDD 27.7% (target <25%, FAIL), IR -0.302 (negative, underperforms BM, FAIL), Calmar 0.14 (FAIL). Strategy dramatically underperforms KOSPI benchmark (BM SR 0.427, CAGR 9.03%). VT15%+DD8/20 overlay crushed already-weak returns. gate3_role_honesty.detail: ROLE FRAUD DETECTED. Claimed role: diversifier. Evidence against: (1) BM_Corr 0.595 -- too high for a genuine diversifier (expect <0.3 for defense, <0.5 for diversifier), (2) IR -0.302 -- negative information ratio means it systematically underperforms BM, (3) S3 orthogonality factor_mean_max_corr 0.83 -- D41 and Q07 are highly redundant with existing factors, novelty_score only 0.17, (4) CAGR 3.87% vs BM 9.03% -- diversifier must at least not destroy capital this severely. Stress 3/3 outperform is the only positive signal, but insufficient to justify diversifier claim given correlated underperformance.

gate4_statistical.detail: DSR: not computed (module unavailable). OOS retention: 0.867 (decent, IS SR 0.381 / OOS SR 0.331). Rolling 3Y Sharpe >0 ratio: 56.5% (barely majority positive). Alpha trend: improving (recent 3Y SR 0.766 vs full 0.364, ratio 2.11). However, base SR 0.364 is statistically indistinguishable from zero given ~20 years of data (t-stat ~1.6). Without DSR confirmation, cannot claim statistical significance. IC stability: not available.

gate5_ff5.detail: No FF5 regression output available for s5_m3 variant. S2 profile shows base strategy FF5 alpha t-stat = -0.35 (insignificant, negative alpha). FMB t-stat = -0.07. The VolVol+Quality factor combination shows no independent alpha beyond Fama-French factors. VT/DD overlay cannot create alpha, only reshape risk -- so FF5 alpha for s5_m3 is expected to be equally or more negative.

Gate 3 FAIL: Role fraud -- claimed diversifier but BM_Corr 0.595, IR negative, factor novelty 0.17
Gate 4 FAIL: No DSR, base SR statistically insignificant
Gate 5 FAIL: No FF5 alpha (S2 base t=-0.35, FMB t=-0.07)
verdict.recommendation: DISCARD. The D41_VolVol + Q07_Earnings_Stability combination lacks independent alpha in the Korean market. S3 already flagged high redundancy (corr 0.83) and recommended STOP. S5 VT15%+DD8/20 mutation reduced MDD from catastrophic 60.5% to 27.7% but destroyed returns further. The Baltussen 2018 vol-of-vol premium does not translate to KOSPI with this construction. Recommend: (1) Do not pursue further S5 mutations on this base, (2) D41_VolVol may have value as a tertiary factor in a 3+ factor blend where it contributes <20% weight, (3) Q07 standalone or in different combination may be more productive.

role_honesty_audit.evidence: BM_Corr 0.595 (too high for diversifier), IR -0.302 (negative), factor novelty_score 0.17, factor_mean_max_corr 0.83. Strategy behaves as a correlated underperformer, not a genuine diversifier. Stress outperformance 3/3 is the sole positive signal but does not offset systematic underperformance.
